question.title: Will Israel withdraw behind the original Yellow Line in Gaza before January 1, 2027?
question.description:
The [“Yellow Line”](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yellow_Line_\(Gaza\)) is a demarcation line (marked by a series of painted cement blocks) that splits Gaza into two sections: most of the Palestinian population is confined in the western zone, while the eastern zone is under Israeli military control. It was initially set up following the announcement of the Israel-Hamas ceasefire agreement of October 2025, and subsequent [Gaza Peace Plan](https://www.cfr.org/articles/guide-trumps-twenty-point-gaza-peace-deal) as part of [the war in Gaza](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gaza_war).

In August 2026, the US-led Board of Peace stated that[ the complete disarmament of Hamas](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/board-of-peace-says-no-israeli-withdrawal-from-gaza-before-hamas-disarms) would be required before Israel would withdraw from the Yellow Line. Progress has stalled, not least because of reports of [Israeli military forces killing people on the Yellow Line](https://www.haaretz.com/israel-news/israel-security/2026-09-03/ty-article-live/idf-troops-kill-two-palestinian-youths-during-settler-raid-medics-say/000001a0-6509-d1e9-ade0-f5dbf60c0000?liveBlogItemId=1379774640#1379774640). In mid-September, the UN reported that [Palestinians live in less than 40 per cent of Gaza’s land area](https://news.un.org/en/story/2026/09/1168320), highlighting the ongoing humanitarian crisis that the war has created. Other reports have indicated that [the Yellow Line is increasingly encroaching further into Gaza](https://www.latimes.com/world-nation/story/2026-08-09/how-israels-moving-yellow-line-border-is-erasing-gazans-lives).

An Israeli withdrawal effectively means that the percentage area of land between the Yellow Line and the eastern perimeter ("Green Line") is less than 53% of Gaza (which was set during the October 10, 2025 ceasefire agreement) and therefore means Israeli forces have retreated:

!['''](https://www.ochaopt.org/sites/default/files/styles/phone_x1_767_/public/statementmap_sitrep-26-june-26.jpg?itok=vV-opJzA)
question.resolution_criteria: This question resolves as **Yes** if, at any point before 1 January 2027, [credible sources](https://www.metaculus.com/faq/#definitions) report that Israeli military forces have announced a withdrawal to a position behind the Yellow Line within Gaza (as defined by the specific map drawn up for the October 2025 ceasefire agreement, illustrated by [the OCHA](https://www.ochaopt.org/content/humanitarian-situation-report-26-june-2026#access-restricted-areas)) and that Israeli military forces have physically withdrawn to such a position that they no longer maintain military control of the area vacated.
question.fine_print:
Any distance behind the Yellow Line will qualify so long as it is announced and maintained for a minimum of a 24-hour period.

The status of the "Orange Lines" is irrelevant to this question.
